subtasks.title: EXPLAIN-first: pick W2 query shape + batching granularity (read-only Cloud)
subtasks.approach: Settle the human-deferred W2 shape empirically before any code. clarity_clickhouse is Cloud-connected and read-only. Run EXPLAIN on clarity.sc_positions over a real dense kit's 15-min window comparing per-kit equality (WHERE lower(kit_mapping) = '<kit>') vs per-org IN (WHERE lower(kit_mapping) IN (<org's kits>)); the optimizer may ignore IN and lose the (kit_mapping, timestamp_utc) prefix prune. Adopt whichever actually prunes, preferring the prune over query count per evidence-38238 (equality prunes 13/32732 granules vs 3056/32732 for lower()). This decision fixes t2's SQL shape AND the batching granularity (per-kit iff equality; per-org iff IN prunes acceptably). Same session measures position_window size/read_rows for a dense kit to size Design Risk 2 (GPS ~3s cadence vs LPR scan cadence the rollup CTE was tuned for).
intended_diffs: Run EXPLAIN indexes=1 / EXPLAIN PLAN + query_log read on clarity_clickhouse: compare per-kit equality vs per-org IN on lower(kit_mapping) over one dense kit's 15-min window; capture granules_read, read_rows, result_rows for both shapes.

Measure position_window row count + read_rows for that dense kit's 15-min window; decide GPS decimation (toStartOfInterval down-sample inside position_window) ONLY if the window proves too large/unselective, else none.

Record SHAPES + AGGREGATES ONLY (granules/read_rows/result_rows, chosen shape, batching granularity per-kit|per-org, decimation yes/no) into docs/investigations/DEV-2342/derivation_log.md. NO raw rows.
NOTE: on the current unprojected sc_positions (pre-W1) BOTH shapes are slow; this decision fixes t2's SQL, not AC2 cadence (W1/W4-gated).

subtasks.title: Rewrite ScoutCheckInMatchQuery as one server-side CTE + AC9 parity test
subtasks.approach: AC1 core. Replace the addresses[]/values()-injection/array_chunk round-trip amplifier with ONE self-contained ClickHouse statement per unit of work at the granularity t1 chose, lifting ScoutCheckInRollupQuery's open_hotlists -> address_links -> addresses CTE onto clarity.sc_positions + lower(kit_mapping). Only ~40 match rows/cycle ever cross into PHP (PG-022 template: O(matches), not O(addresses)). Second file authors the AC9 parity test proving the rewritten matcher and the UNTOUCHED ScoutCheckInRollupQuery agree on the same inputs (they read different LHS tables, sc_positions vs scans, but share one domain rule). Grounded: rollup CTE at ScoutCheckInRollupQuery.php:83-159; binding hazards in its docblock (lines 20-48).
intended_diffs: ScoutCheckInMatchQuery.php: replace matchChunk/addressValues/floatLiteral/ADDRESS_CHUNK with a single CTE at t1's granularity: position_window (clarity.sc_positions, lower(kit_mapping) = or IN per t1, timestamp_utc window, geo tuple != 0) -> position_bbox (pad BBOX_PAD_DEGREES 0.003) -> open_hotlists (clarity.hotlist FINAL, _peerdb_is_deleted=0, status=Open, length(plate)>3, hotlistOrgFilter) -> address_links (self::zodDb().public_hotlist_address, DISTINCT, _peerdb_is_deleted=0, carries is_staged+hotlist_id) -> addresses (self::zodDb().public_address, id IN (subquery) prune KEPT alongside the address_links INNER JOIN, extract()+toFloat64OrNull EWKT, NO FINAL, bbox-clipped) -> geoDistance(...) <= 160.934 join -> GROUP BY (address_id, hour_bucket).

Keep VERBATIM the outer tie-break: argMin(hotlist_id,(toUInt8(is_staged),hotlist_id)) + min(is_staged) direct-wins, and argMin((lng,lat),timestamp_utc) single-tuple coordinate pick + min(timestamp_utc) matched_at.

Prefer self::zodDb() over hardcoded 'zod.' (matches the class this rewrite absorbs, not the rollup's literal hardcode). If t1 chose decimation, add toStartOfInterval down-sample inside position_window only.

Update handle() to {kit_mapping|kit_mappings, start, end} per t1; drop the addresses param; return list<{address_id,hotlist_id,is_staged,hour_bucket,matched_at,lat,lng}> unchanged shape. Keep static handle() no-constructor sibling convention; preserve load-bearing docblock rationale, update it to describe server-side enumeration.

New tests/Unit/Clickhouse/Queries/ScoutCheckInMatchQueryParityTest.php (RequiresClickhouse): seed identical clarity.hotlist + zod.public_hotlist_address + zod.public_address fixtures AND both a clarity.sc_positions fix and a clarity.scans_{hot,cold} row at the same location/time; assert the rewritten matcher and the untouched ScoutCheckInRollupQuery agree on the matched (address,hour) set + direct/staging tie-break at boundary cases (exactly 160.934m, inside-bbox-outside-radius, hour-boundary straddle, same-address direct+staging). Anchor fixtures to now() (CH hot-table 90d TTL).

subtasks.title: Rewrite recorder: bulk insert + W3 semaphore + AC7 ::handle() bypass; delete dead query; config/route hygiene
subtasks.approach: AC1/AC3/AC4/AC7. Drop the per-org address enumeration + array threading; call the rewritten matcher once per unit of work (per-kit or per-org per t1) via ::handle() DIRECTLY so real CH exceptions reach the existing try/catch (AC7 - do NOT touch the shared ClickhouseQuery::query() swallow, Q6). Replace the per-match firstOrCreate() loop with one bulk insertOrIgnore against the existing unique index. Add the W3 hard concurrency ceiling: an N-slot Cache::lock semaphore acquired at command start, no-op if no slot free (ceiling independent of runtime, AC4), released in finally; slot lease TTL <= lookback preserves the DEV-2348 zero-loss coupling (today 10 < 15). Delete the now-orphaned ScoutOpenOrderAddressesQuery. Retire dead config; correct (not uncomment) the discredited routes comment.
intended_diffs: ScoutRecordCheckIns.php: remove openOrderAddressesForOrg() + the per-org $addresses cache + $addresses threading through recordCheckInsForKit(); call ScoutCheckInMatchQuery::handle(...) DIRECTLY (not ::query()) so a dead CH throws into the existing per-org/per-kit try/catch instead of returning [] (AC7); if any caching is still wanted, wrap the call site in an explicit Cache::remember, NOT ::query().

ScoutRecordCheckIns.php: replace the firstOrCreate() loop with one ScoutCheckIn::query()->insertOrIgnore($rows) against unique(kit_id,address_id,hour_bucket); use the returned inserted-row count for $recorded; stamp created_at/updated_at manually (insertOrIgnore bypasses model events). Eager-load kits (remove the per-driver Kit::find N+1). Keep the completion-summary + overrun report().

ScoutRecordCheckIns.php: add the W3 N-slot Cache::lock semaphore at handle() start (config-driven slot count + lease TTL, no fallback); if no slot is free, log + return SUCCESS as a no-op (hard ceiling AC4); release the slot in a finally. Do NOT let the discredited 'concurrency is load-bearing' reasoning inform this.

DELETE app/Clickhouse/Queries/ScoutOpenOrderAddressesQuery.php and its `use` import (grep-confirmed sole callers: this recorder + the command test; recoverable from git per Q9). Its inline coverage in the command test is removed in t4.

config/scout.php: remove the now-dead address_cache_ttl_minutes knob; add the W3 knob(s) (e.g. max_concurrent_slots + slot_lease_minutes) under the file's no-fallback discipline (call sites read config with no fallback); do NOT guess a new overrun_ms (measurement-gated, Q5) - leave it as-is.

routes/console.php: leave the ScoutRecordCheckIns schedule block COMMENTED (W4 deferred - do NOT uncomment). Correct ONLY the stale line-66 comment ('the concurrency is currently what keeps the recorder up / bounding duration first'), falsified by the 2026-08-12 OOM, to a neutral 'disabled pending DEV-2342 W1/W4 re-enable' note. okf wiki page correction is POST-APPROVAL.
